title: Yellow Creamy Mediterranean Kidney Beans Stew
description: A comforting and flavorful stew featuring kidney beans, papillote, and a blend of Mediterranean spices, perfect for a sick day. This macrobiotic-friendly dish is pungent, creamy, and sure to satisfy.

ingredients.name: kidney beans
ingredients.notes: canned can be used as substitute

instructions: Rinse the dried kidney beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the soaked kidney beans, then transfer them to a large pot with enough water to cover them.
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the kidney beans for 45 minutes or until they are tender.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Stir in the paprika, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked kidney beans, coconut cream, and lemon juice to the skillet, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew for 10-15 minutes, until the flavors have melded together and the stew has thickened slightly.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed, then serve the stew hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
